definition: to use a short chance as fully as possible
description: On a snowy office rooftop between tall glass towers, a young man in a white shirt, tie and sunglasses, trousers rolled up, leans back in a striped deckchair in the one narrow beam of sunshine, his bare feet in a small inflatable paddling pool, holding an ice cream cone and enjoying the sun. Colleagues in winter coats and scarves stand behind him laughing, some filming with their phones. A pigeon sits on the snowy ledge beside an air-conditioning unit.

taps.phrase: to film him on her phone
to perch on a snowy ledge
